title: PROPOSED MONUMENT: MARY CLAY SCHOOL
text:
PROPOSED MONUMENT: MARY CLAY SCHOOL

  CHC-2026-1489-HCM
  CEQA: ENV-2026-1490-CE  Council District: 10 – Hutt
  Plan Area: West Adams – Baldwin Hills – Leimert  Last Day to Act: 08-07-26

  PROPERTY ADDRESS:  3911 West Adams Boulevard

  REQUESTED ACTIONS:
  1. Determine that the proposed designation is categorically exempt from the California Environmental
  Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Article 19, Section 15308, Class 8 and Article 19, Section 15331,
  Class 31 of the State CEQA Guidelines;
  2. Determine whether the property conforms with the definition of a Monument pursuant to Los Angeles
  Administrative Code Section 22.171.7; and
  3. Recommend that the City Council consider and declare the subject property a Historic-Cultural
  Monument.

  Owner:  West Adams LLC

  Applicant:  City of Los Angeles

  Preparer:  Office of Historic Resources, Los Angeles City Planning
summary: Proposed designation of Mary Clay School as Historic-Cultural Monument at 3911 West Adams Boulevard.

locations.text: 3911 West Adams Boulevard, Los Angeles, CA
